title: JA4proxy ECS Event
description: Validates the mandatory ECS 8.x fields present in every JA4proxy telemetry event. Used by CI to guard against schema drift. Note: ECS uses dotted-key notation — field names like 'source.ip' are literal JSON keys, not nested objects.

@timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with millisecond precision and UTC timezone marker.

event.kind.description: High-level categorisation of the event. 'event' for connection decisions, 'alert' for analytics findings (campaigns, score drift).

event.action.description: The action taken by JA4proxy for this connection. Maps directly to the ActionDecider output.

event.outcome.description: ECS outcome from the defender's perspective: 'success' = allowed (no threat), 'failure' = blocked/banned/tarpitted.

event.risk_score.description: Composite risk score 0–100 produced by the RiskScorer.

service.name.description: Must always be 'ja4proxy'. Used by SIEM rules to scope queries to this product.

service.version.description: Semver string identifying the JA4proxy release.

network.transport.description: Transport layer protocol. JA4proxy only handles TCP.

network.protocol.description: Application layer protocol — always 'tls' for this proxy.

source.ip.description: Client IP address (IPv4 or IPv6). When behind HAProxy with PROXY protocol, this is the real client IP extracted from the PROXY protocol header.

host.name.description: Hostname of the JA4proxy instance that processed this connection.

ja4proxy.dial_setting.description: The proxy dial position (0–100) at the time of this connection. Dial=0 is monitor-only mode.

ja4proxy.score.description: Alias for event.risk_score retained for backward compatibility with pre-ECS log consumers.

ja4proxy.signals.description: Array of individual RiskSignal objects that contributed to the composite score.

name.description: Signal identifier matching the Prometheus label used in ja4proxy_signal_score_total.

score.description: Points contributed to the composite score by this signal.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this signal fired.

ja4proxy.sni.description: TLS SNI hostname extracted from the ClientHello.

ja4proxy.alpn.description: First ALPN protocol offered by the client (e.g. 'h2', 'http/1.1').

ja4proxy.tls_resumed.description: True if the client reused a TLS session ticket (session resumption).

ja4proxy.asn.description: Autonomous System Number of the client IP.

ja4proxy.asn_org.description: ASN organisation name from MaxMind GeoLite2-ASN.

ja4proxy.country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the client IP.

ja4proxy.node.description: JA4proxy instance identifier. Matches host.name for single-node deployments.
